language_subtitle: Select your preferred language to continue.
hero_title: Understand your crop from a single leaf.
hero_description: Upload a clear image of a crop leaf and AgriSakha will analyze it for possible diseases or healthy conditions.
upload_description: Upload an image to get an AI-powered prediction.
supported_formats: JPG, PNG or WEBP · photos are compressed automatically
disclaimer: This result is an AI-based first-level assessment and should not replace professional agricultural advice.
prediction_error: Unable to analyze the image. Please try again.
capabilities_title: Built for the field, not just the lab
capabilities_subtitle: Everything you need, in one simple, multilingual tool.
feature_diagnosis_desc: Upload one clear image and get a crop and disease reading in seconds.
feature_multilingual_desc: Use AgriSakha fully in English, Hindi or Marathi — no translating needed.
feature_confidence_desc: Every result comes with a visual confidence score, not just a guess.
feature_guidance_desc: Get symptoms, prevention tips and next steps, not just a diagnosis.
feature_responsive_desc: Built to run well on the everyday phones farmers actually use.
feature_fast_desc: No waiting, no queue — get your reading right after you upload.
step1_desc: Take a clear photo of the affected leaf and upload it.
step2_desc: The model checks the leaf against common crop diseases.
step3_desc: See the diagnosis, confidence score and what to do next.
drop_hint: or drag, drop or paste a leaf photo here
tip_1: Shoot in daylight and avoid harsh shadows
tip_2: Show one leaf, close up, filling the frame
tip_3: Keep the leaf in focus and hold the camera steady
tip_4: Make sure the affected area is clearly visible
result_empty_desc: Add a leaf photo and tap the analyze button to see the diagnosis, risk level and what to do next.
risk_note: Typical risk of this condition if it is left untreated.
heatmap_hint: Warmer colours mark the parts of the leaf that influenced the result most.
helpline_desc: Call the Kisan Call Centre (toll-free) to talk to an agricultural expert.
uncertain_desc: The model isn't confident enough to give a diagnosis from this photo. Please retake it and try again.
uncertain_tip: Use daylight, show one leaf up close and keep it in focus.
faq1_a: Rice, maize, soyabean, wheat, groundnut, potato, tomato and cotton, including healthy leaves, common diseases and some pest damage.
faq2_a: No. Your photo is analysed in memory to produce the result and is not saved on the server. Recent results stay only on your own device.
faq3_q: Can I rely on the result?
faq3_a: Treat it as a quick first check. Accuracy depends on photo quality, and a low-confidence result is flagged instead of guessed. For treatment decisions, talk to an agricultural expert.
footer_note: Made for farmers. AI-powered crop health assistance.
err_invalid_image: This file doesn't look like a valid JPG, PNG or WEBP image.
err_too_large: This image is too large. Please choose a smaller photo.
err_server: Something went wrong while analysing the photo. Please try again.
err_network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
